messages:
lena: Quick sync — we need to align on an instrumentation priority matrix for the Console observability work next quarter. Main asks from PM/AE: dashboards (cost + latency), tracing hooks, cost breakdown per-route, and error analytics for regressions. Can we sketch priorities + launch criteria? cc @sam @mike @anya @tomas

sam: +1. My rough priority: 1) cost breakdown per-route/model = must-have for enterprise buyers. 2) dashboards baseline (p50/p95/p99, tokens, errors) = must-have. 3) tracing hooks + sampling = should-have. 4) error analytics (grouping/RCA) = could/iterate. Need owners and minimally viable scope.

mike: From SRE side: tracing hooks + sampling controls are critical for incident investigation. Without sampling/controls we'll drown in trace volume. Proposal: deliver tracing SDK + sampling UI in v1, full trace search and span UI in v2.

anya: For analytics: error analytics needs a normalized taxonomy (model-error vs infra-error) and grouping by stack/trace + model-id. MVP: aggregated error groups + time-series + sample traces. ETA ~3 sprints if we reuse existing grouping logic.

tomas: Customer input: three pilots explicitly asked for per-route cost breakdown to justify Dedicated commits. This is basically a gating feature for those deals — mark it must-have for launch of the cost story.

lena: Agree. Proposed compact priority matrix: Must: cost per-route/model variant, dashboards baseline (latency, p99, error-rate), basic error counts and grouping. Should: tracing hooks (SDK) + sampling UI, token-level cost view, export CSVs. Could: full trace search, RCA workflow UI, built-in alert templates. Objections?

sam: No objections. A couple implementation notes: cost breakdown must be batching-aware (requests may be merged), and account for prefix cache effects. Suggested minimal schema for telemetry events:

```
{
  "route_id": "string",
  "request_id": "string",
  "model_variant": "string",
  "tokens_charged": "int",
  "duration_ms": "int",
  "cost_unit": "float",
  "sampled_trace_id": "string (nullable)"
}
```

We also need a mapping layer from internal model names -> customer-facing model label for billing.

mike: Rollout / launch criteria suggestions: feature-flagged rollout, canary on Dedicated customers, automated smoke tests to verify per-request accounting, and SLA checks: 99% of demo flows under latency SLO and cost variance <5% vs offline calc. Also no PII in exported traces.

anya: Success metrics: adoption rate (routes instrumented), number of customers using cost export, mean cost variance, reduction in incident time-to-ack for traced incidents. Target: 25 customers opt-in for cost breakdown in first 30 days, and 30% reduction in debug time for incidents that use traces.

tomas: Customers also asked for: per-team billing exports (CSV), ability to tag routes with product-line, and a simple UI to attribute spending to teams. Those are high-value but we can deliver CSV initially.

lena: Scope negotiation note: if we must cut scope for v1, drop full trace search and RCA UI; keep SDK + sampling + link from request -> sampled trace. Keep cost breakdown and dashboards as top priority.

sam: Timeline proposal: MVP spec doc by EOD Friday, implementation spike next week (2 engs x 2 weeks), staging demo in 4 weeks. Owners: sam (eng lead), anya (data lead), mike (sre lead). I'll create epics and rough task estimates after the spec.

tomas: :thumbsup: I'll gather the customer ask docs and example CSVs and post them in the drive.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: observability/proto v1 -> canary on staging at 1769005000

lena: Thanks all — I'll update the roadmap doc and create JIRA epics. If no objections, I'll lock priorities by EOD tomorrow.
